title: Response to Welcome (Address at the World's Parliament of Religions, Chicago)

publication.publisher_or_container: The Complete Works of Swami Vivekananda, vol. 1 (Addresses at the Parliament of Religions)

verification.verification_notes: Delivered 11 September 1893 at the World's Parliament of Religions, Chicago; date, venue, and textual tradition confirmed via Wikisource, the Parliament of the World's Religions, and the Art Institute of Chicago. Contemporary newspaper reports of the address exist; the received version is a later reconstruction. No passage reproduced.

copyright.notes: Vivekananda died 1902; the address text is in the public domain. No passage reproduced regardless.
